@guardian #metoo isn't about punishing men for awkward sexual advances. It's abt not allowing men to punish women for saying no!

Don't want to be accused?

TAKE NO FOR AN ANSWER.

It's time to retire the MYTH of women playing some kind of seductive game by saying no when they mean yes.

@poles38 @Oprah @RWitherspoon @shondarhimes @AmericaFerrera @TraceeEllisRoss @CBSSunday For same reason women trying 2b famous now haven't talked UNTIL NOW. They can talk NOW bc of #metoo. I guarantee if #metoo happened 10-20 yrs ago, these now famous women wd have talked THEN

Women don't talk when the system makes certain their lives will be miserable if they talk

@washingtonpost And you wouldn't be covering this so extensively before coverage of the Weinstein and subsequent cases, as well as the #metoo movement that followed, became such a powerful force on behalf of sexually abused women and girls everywhere.

@washingtonpost The next NFL [or NBA or?] 'Ray Rice' won't get off so easily. The #MeTOO mvt has made it impossible...look at what happened the instant the man's history became widely known.

Unfortunately, most DV & sex assault victims don't get that attention bc their perps aren't well-known.

@counterchekist @MichellesDude And by dumping identity politics you mean what?

The party has to dump Black Lives Matter?

Turn a blind eye to #MeToo?

Pretend racism embeded in the anti-immigration movement isn't there? 

Focus on white working class men?

Pretend racism can be resolved w/economic policies?

@guardian Had men actually listened, there wouldn't have been any need for #metoo, because the men would have STOPPED THE SHIT THEMSELVES.

Wanna say 'not all men'? Fine, not all men DO that shit. But the vast majority have STOOD BACK AND LET IT HAPPEN. With ungodly regularity.

@BlondeHistorian @WheelsofSteer Same argument men use against the #metoo movement. 'You think this is bad, you should try living in Iran.' Also used against any other cogent argument for change.

We're supposed to be better. We pride ourselves in being the first to improve. So why stop trying to change now?

@girlsreallyrule It is the STRUCTURAL POWER of the #meToo movement that empowers the women to finally speak on their own behalf, knowing that even tho there still will be many who disbelieve and attack them, there's a critical mass of people calling BS on the harassers and their apologists.

@TVietor08 @NYCNavid We can support the women &pursue the charges, but that shouldn't stop us from looking askance at why wasn't this brought forward when the #MeToo movement was snowballing in the fall? not questioning the women's motives--but I've no doubt there's an R-winger behind the timing

@archistruct @VictoriaBanvil2 @B52Malmet @GualtieriEdward @calabra46 @POTUS No, #MeToo is not a form of McCarthyism. It's a moment in history when women finally get to talk about all the shit they've had to deal with being harassed, assaulted, and raped by men and then getting blamed for it happening to them.  /2
